tests.name: Identity explicit recovery keeps verification retry immutable after an unknown acknowledgement and never retries automatically
Identity explicit recovery clears an unknown verification intent on session-epoch change
Identity explicit recovery does not bypass server verification wait and uses a minimum 60-second cooldown
Identity explicit recovery checks session explicitly after a forbidden verification response
Identity explicit recovery never sends an empty resend email or announces initial acceptance
Identity explicit recovery serializes resend clicks and does not use an edited email while pending
Identity explicit recovery changing resend email does not remove the cooldown
Identity explicit recovery monotonic resend wait survives wall-clock jumps and unlocks only after its duration
Identity explicit recovery register does not put email or password in browser history and does not log in
clears resend identity and pending state when an anonymous session epoch changes
